newsitem.title: TAIWAN: High waves in Taiwan kill two, three missing.
newsitem.headline: High waves in Taiwan kill two, three missing.

text.p: Turbulent waves swept more than 10 fishermen into the sea from a pier at Taiwan's northern Keelung port, killing at least two and sparking a search for three others, state-run television said on Tuesday.
Those who managed to swim ashore said they were fishing on the pier when the waves rose and engulfed them late on Monday, the broadcast said.
Police have found two bodies and were searching for other victims, with three fishermen still unaccounted for.
"We have to continue our search in order to have a more definite conclusion on casualty figures," Keelung police chief Wu Chang-kuan told reporters.
Taiwan's northern and northeastern waters have had dangerously choppy waves in the wake of Typhoon Zane, which passed through at the weekend before veering toward Japan.
